_note: Fully synthetic English re-identification-risk eval fixture. No real people. Separate single-language pool (NOT merged with the zh fixture): mixing scripts lets an LLM re-identify trivially by language, inflating the metric. 18 personas, each a 9-attribute quasi-identifier vector over the STANDARD inference taxonomy from Staab et al. (the AURA line of work): age, sex, location, occupation, education, relationship_status, income, place_of_birth — PLUS medical_condition as an argus-relevant 9th sensitive attribute. Fully NON-CONFOUNDED: EVERY value of EVERY one of the 9 fields is shared by >=2 personas (9 ages x2, 2 sexes ~x9, 6 locations x3, 9 occupations x2, 3 education levels x6, 3 relationship statuses x6, 3 income bands x6, 3 places of birth x6, 9 medical conditions x2), so NO single field re-identifies anyone. Only the FULL 9-tuple is unique per persona, so identity is recoverable solely by COMBINING >=2 residual quasi-identifiers. Each candidate summary lists ONLY the 9 quasi-identifiers and NO explicit PII. Each profile is prose weaving explicit PII (a varied US/UK name + fictional-range phone + email) plus the SAME 9 residual attributes, so after explicit-PII removal only the partially-discriminating quasi-identifiers remain — exactly the survivors a re-identification attack must combine.
